observations.uncertainty: Measured on fixed OSM polygon data; source survey accuracy unknown; planning tolerance±5m. Roof/body boundaries not distinguished in OSM.
Official reported height, not field-measured. Decimal precision does not establish survey accuracy or absolute ground datum.
Other four coarse estimated±6–7m as detailed in spec; cropped/occluded photos do not support calibrated photogrammetry; absolute ground elevations unknown.
Computed minimum-area rectangles of source polygons; planning±3deg, not measured survey accuracy. Southeast facade/uphill northwest linked by official hall sequence.

observations.value: Five distinct axial shells; Grand Hall triple eaves/hipped-gabled roof; other visible paired eaves, upward corners, red timber rhythm and yellow end walls.
observations.uncertainty: Reference-informed exterior only; Huayan and Kings roof extents partly obscured/cropped; exact roof joinery, ornament and backside pending.

observations.value: Five absolute game-Y bases supplied externally; no automatic DSM/floor inference; original shells retained; local terrace/stairs openly estimated.
observations.uncertainty: Exactfloor/step/whole-boundary/continuousroute remains pending; explicit caller input does not certify real elevation.

observations.value: Reference-transcribed traditional plaques, sparse pale stone balustrades/paving and representative curling roof ridge ends.
observations.uncertainty: No photo texture/traced calligraphy, scanned relief or final material/visual claim.
